sourceClaims.claim: A source spacing token is used only where its semantics are global.
Repeated component geometry remains local unless a global semantic contract is established.

evidence.source-integrity: pass: source tests retain exactly the nine-value 4/8/16/24/32/40/48/56/64px scale
evidence.structural-contract: pass: generation emits one resolved CSS custom property for every authored spacing value
evidence.runtime-browser: pass: a focused browser assertion resolves the representative stack gap to the authored 16px value
evidence.accessibility: not-applicable: the spacing scale defines values but no standalone accessibility behavior
evidence.focused-visual: pass: exact computed geometry verifies the representative 16px stack spacing without relying on a broad screenshot
evidence.consumer-integration: pass: representative stack and Data Workspace compositions consume the published spacing layer while component-specific geometry remains local
evidence.responsive-content-stress: not-applicable: the global spacing values are viewport-independent; responsive layout behavior belongs to consuming components
